onboardingIntro.message: Bulk delete your own posts and messages across Slack, Reddit, X, Mastodon, Microsoft Teams, and Telegram — pick a platform below to get started.

onboardingBullet1.message: 🔒 All processing happens locally in your browser

onboardingBullet3.message: 🗑️ Deletions are permanent — review carefully first

onboardingBullet4.message: 🔑 Each platform only asks for access when you open it

onboardingPrivacy.message: This is an independent tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the platforms above. It uses your own existing login session on each one to delete content on your behalf; deletions are permanent. No data is sent to external servers.

dashTextMatchPlain.description: Non-Slack dashboards' text filter label -- unlike Slack's, this field never treats a /slash-wrapped/ value as a regular expression, so it's labeled distinctly to avoid the same convention being assumed here

dashIncludeThreadsDesc.message: Scan and delete messages inside threads

dashOnlyAttachmentsDesc.message: Strips files/attachments but keeps any message text (a message that is only a file is deleted)

dashSkipPinnedDesc.message: Never delete a message that is currently pinned in this conversation

dashTextMatchRegexHint.message: Wrap in / / to use a regular expression, e.g. /ERR_\d+/. Plain text otherwise.
dashTextMatchRegexHint.description: Dashboard: small caption under the Text Match field explaining the /regex/ convention in-app, not just in the README

dashPresetSave.description: Dashboard: save current filters as a preset

dashActivityLog.description: Collapsible troubleshooting log toggle on the five non-Slack dashboards

dashCancelNoResumeHint.message: Stops the delete entirely -- there's no pause/resume on this platform.
dashCancelNoResumeHint.description: Tooltip on the five non-Slack dashboards' Cancel button, clarifying it's a full stop, not a pause (unlike Slack's Start/Pause/Resume cycle)

logWorkspaceSwitchPause.message: [Warning] Workspace switch detected! Bulk clean auto-paused to avoid operating on the wrong workspace.

logScanTimeout.message: No scan result after 2 minutes. The background worker may have been suspended, or may still be working through a throttled channel. Re-run Scan — a scan that is still running will say so rather than starting a second one.

logResumeReqFailed.message: Resume request failed — background unavailable. Reload Slack if this persists.

logResumeNoJob.message: Resume request reached the background worker, but it found no matching job — nothing was resumed.

No result came back within 2 minutes. The background worker was either suspended or is still working through a heavily rate-limited channel.

Re-run Scan: if one is still in progress you'll be told, and nothing is deleted either way.
